top_issues: Total balance $115.00 but On-chain $0.00, Reserve $0.00 and 'At risk $115.00': the headline number is 100% counterparty promise, nowhere flagged as such at the top
Balance bars use different colors per legend swatch but the H1 account bar (green+purple) is unreadable without the legend; no hover/labels on segments
'1 empty hidden' and '~$0.00' for WETH are unexplained; new users cannot tell if $0.00 means nothing or something hidden
Left rail icons have no labels; 'synced' status dot is tiny and unexplained
fixes: Add a caption under Total balance: 'On-chain $0 · Secured $0 · $115 is a hub promise' with link to Sovereignty
Label balance bar segments inline at larger widths (e.g. '115 at risk' inside the purple segment)
Replace '1 empty hidden' with a count '1 hidden empty token'

top_issues: Full 40-char counterparty hex shown under the recipient name creates noise; truncated 0x92c2d7c3...b2cbf0 suffices
'send up to 215.00' / 'receive up to 0.50' microcopy sits far from the bar it annotates and is easy to miss
No explicit confirmation of recipient identity (e.g. address book name match / checksum highlight) before sending $25
fixes: Truncate address to 10+4 with copy affordance
Move capacity line directly under the amount field as a hint chip
Add a contact-name/avatar verification row for a known address

top_issues: 'Settled 05:25:19 in 7979 ms' — 8 seconds labeled with a green 'in' reads oddly; users may think settlement took 8s vs instant claim elsewhere
Proof hash truncated but no way to copy or view the frame from this modal
No share/forward action on the receipt (persona: Sofia needs a forwardable receipt)
fixes: Clarify 'confirmed in 8.0s' with tooltip on what settling means
Add copy-proof and 'View frame #131' links
Add Share / Copy receipt button

top_issues: QR code renders on a light card only; no amount encoded by default so it is just an address QR until the user types 0.00
'25.50 capacity via H1' label is cryptic; a first-timer cannot tell this caps what senders can push
'Copy xln:// app link' jargon term 'xln://' unexplained
fixes: Update QR live as the amount is typed and show encoded payload preview
Rewrite capacity line: 'Friends can send you up to 25.50 instantly via H1'

top_issues: 'You receive 0.00' with no quote: user must infer fill price from the book; no market/limit toggle clarity
'Lot rounding: 0.000004 USDC stays with you' is unexplained minutiae in the summary block
Order book axis: price levels good, but no depth numbers or cumulative size
fixes: Precompute receive estimate from best available level and label it 'est. at 2,500.5000'
Move lot rounding to an info tooltip
Add cumulative depth column

top_issues: Legend (collateral / at risk / you owe / credit room / in flight) is tiny text at 10px, hard to map to bar segments
'Their credit line to you 0.00' vs 'Your credit line to them 115.50' reads backwards for newcomers; direction unclear
WETH lane with all zeros occupies equal visual weight as the active USDC lane
fixes: Enlarge legend and attach it to the bar with connector ticks
Rename to 'Hub lets you spend up to 0.00' / 'You extend to hub 115.50'
Collapse zero-balance lanes by default

top_issues: Only 'TODAY' grouping with 7 items; no date navigation or pagination for real history
Detail card right side duplicates the selected row without scroll affordance; '2 committed entries' link is unexplained
'closed' vs 'settled' vs 'created' status dots are gray/green with no legend
fixes: Add date grouping beyond TODAY and an infinite scroll or month picker
Tooltip the '2 committed entries' with the frame list

top_issues: Identical frame to 07-activity.png: no expanded detail state, so the 'detail' deliverable shows nothing new
Proof hash truncated without copy; To address truncated without copy
No way to jump to the frame explorer or export this single movement
fixes: Capture the actual expanded detail state for review
Add copy buttons on proof/to fields and 'Open frame' link

top_issues: 'Dollars per pixel' scale concept is unique but its explanation ('every bar drawn to one scale') appears only here, not on Home where bars confuse users
'Sample $1,284,500.00' preview with a single green bar does not show multi-segment composition, so the scale preview is weaker than the concept
RUNTIME/VAULT blocks (frame #63, runtime id, mnemonic reveal) sit low with no grouping from design settings; destructive 'Forget vault' near 'Lock'
fixes: Reuse the scale explainer inline on Home first launch
Show the sample as a segmented bar (on-chain/reserve/at risk), not one solid green
Separate RUNTIME and VAULT into a distinct Security section with destructive actions isolated

top_issues: Red error 'Amount exceeds what is available here' but selected FROM card shows '0.00 USDC' while amount 250 is pre-filled: the form arrives in a broken state with no guidance
'Fund you through H1' explainer contradicts the visible FROM=Reserve→TO=Account selection semantics
Buttons 'Sign & send' disabled without stating which condition unblocks it
fixes: Default amount to max-available or clear it; put the error inside the amount field
Make the WHAT HAPPENS panel track the actual selected FROM→TO pair

top_issues: Six destination cards (Sovereignty/Move/Assets/Lending/Ownership) plus an Accounts card: grid order has no logic and Ownership is orphaned on row 3
'Promised by hubs $90.00' in violet is the key risk number but visually equal to Total; not clickable to Sovereignty
'NEEDS ATTENTION — Nothing waiting on you' is an empty block spending a full card
fixes: Order cards by user frequency (Move, Assets, Lending, Sovereignty, Ownership)
Make the violet 'Promised by hubs' row a link to Sovereignty
Hide the attention card when empty or shrink it to a one-line status

top_issues: Right column stacks three unrelated flows (faucet, prepare-to-receive collateral slider, then four action buttons) into one visual blob; 'Collateral unavailable' disabled button buried mid-panel
'Need 74.499977 USDC more' with a slider at 0% collateral — the default position blocks the primary action with no hint how to proceed
'Depository may pull 0.00' allowance line unexplained and repeated 3×
fixes: Split faucet, incoming-account setup and withdrawal into tabs or separate cards
Default the slider to a feasible position and state why 'Collateral unavailable'
Tooltip the allowance line once, not per token

top_issues: 'Interest you ask · basis points 100' with '= 100% per term' is alarming and unlabeled as testnet-default; no APR comparison
H1 POOL panel shows all zeros: Available 0.00, Borrowed 0.00 — no sense of market or liquidity
Term options 1 hour/1 day/1 month as cards but no yield preview per term
fixes: Replace bps with % APR and show projected return per term
Show pool utilization and any offers even at zero, e.g. 'No active offers yet'

top_issues: Screen is nearly empty: a 4-row board table and one empty-state card; 'Lazy (hash of its board)' is jargon with no plain-language gloss
'Register it on the EntityProvider' names a contract with no action link
No board member list, no shares table, nothing for the Ravi/DAO persona to act on
fixes: Add a 'Register board' action and plain copy: 'This wallet is controlled by 1 key: yours'
Add shares/members table placeholder with real fields

top_issues: 'Enforceable right now $0.00' as the hero number is honest but reads as 'you have nothing' to a new user; on-chain $0/Reserve $0 breakdown needed one level up
'Trust only $90.00' violet label is good but the bar legend duplicates the Manage screen wording differently ('Collateral behind what you are owed')
Dispute path hidden in per-counterparty card microcopy ('open → Manage → Dispute') instead of an explicit Dispute button
fixes: Add a Dispute H1 button on the counterparty card
Standardize the green/violet vocabulary across Manage, Home and Sovereignty

top_issues: Dense table is excellent for Marcus but columns SECURED/AT RISK/YOU OWE use '·' for zero, requiring legend decoding
Order book overlaps viewport edge at this width (right rail clipped at 1280px)
Footer row 'Reserve · on-chain' mixes two distinct locations in one line
fixes: Show 0.00 instead of '·' or color-dim zeros
Give the book column a min-width and let the table scroll horizontally instead of clipping

top_issues: Command palette overlays but backdrop does not dim the desk enough; underlying numbers bleed through the panel
Right-hand keywords ('send money', 'invoice, QR') are good but right-aligned against the panel edge with no gutter
No visible keyboard hint for execute (Enter) or cancel (Esc) inside the panel
fixes: Increase backdrop opacity to ~0.6 and add a subtle shadow
Add '↵ select · esc close' footer hint

overall.verdict: A genuinely differentiated wallet: the one-scale bar system, provenance receipts and the Sovereignty view communicate a real safety model better than any mainstream competitor. It is held back by jargon load (credit line, capacity, lazy board, collateral %) and a few screens that ship broken or empty states (Move pre-error, Assets blocked default, Ownership shell).
priority_fixes: Standardize the money-location vocabulary (on-chain / reserve / at-risk / promised) and put the '$X is a hub promise' caveat directly under the Home hero number
Fix Move's default broken state (amount 250 vs 0 available) and make WHAT HAPPENS track the actual selection
Repair Assets: split the right column into tabs and default the collateral slider to a feasible position so 'Receive USDC from H1' is actionable
Add forward/share to the receipt and copy/view-proof affordances (Sofia, Ravi, Kenji)
Give every zero-balance lane and empty block a collapsed or explained state (Account WETH lane, Manage attention card, Ownership board)

personas.name: Maya
personas.verdict: Paying took three screens and worked, but I never understood that my $115 is just a promise from a 'hub' until I stumbled on Sovereignty.
blockers: 01-home: total balance looks like normal money with no on-chain caveat
04-receive: 'capacity via H1' and 'xln://' are jargon
no guided onboarding surfaced on first run

personas.name: Tomasz
personas.verdict: Credit vs collateral is actually explained on the account view and Sovereignty, which no Lightning wallet does; risk per counterparty is visible.
blockers: 06-account: legend text too small to map bar segments in 30s
'credit line to you/them' direction is ambiguous

personas.name: Anya
personas.verdict: A real resting limit order book inside a wallet is great, but I had to read the book myself to know what I'd get.
blockers: 05-swap: no estimated receive amount or market price reference
no fill history beyond a single 'Swap placed/closed' pair in 07-activity

personas.name: Ravi

personas.name: Sofia

blockers: 03-receipt: no share/copy-receipt button

no challenge-window countdown or dispute state visible anywhere in the set

personas.name: Lena
personas.verdict: Only desktop-dark screenshots are in this set; nothing here proves a one-handed 10-second mobile payment exists.
blockers: no mobile variant provided for review (required by task)
desktop Pay form is not thumb-optimized evidence

personas.verdict: 'Across networks' tab and multi-hub routes exist, but the fee shown on the second route is the only cross-chain signal and no bridge timing/status is visible.

no cross-network progress or hop-by-hop status screen
